verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API (endpoints, OAuth 2.0, Batch API, webhooks) and an MCP connector, but nothing mentions official SDKs or client libraries. A raw REST API is a developer building block, not an official SDK, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404, so there is no evidence of generated clients either. Official SDKs are a fair ask for a SaaS work-management platform, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
